Desert Falcon.name: Desert Falcon
Desert Falcon.summary: Desert Falcon is a 3D (isometric) flying shooter game that was developed and published in 1987 by Atari. The game was released for the Atari 2600, 7800, and XE Game Systems of the Atari 8-bit family.

Party Mix.name: Party Mix
Party Mix.summary: Call some friends and mix it up with five wild and crazy games: Bop a Buggy, Tug of War, Wizards' Keep, Down on the Line, and Handcar. Go head-to-head, or in teams of two. Compete against people, not a cold computer. Everyone plays at once.

Stone Age.name: Stone Age
Stone Age.summary: The player controls a caveman whose mission over a 75 second time clock is to kill dinosaurs by throwing rocks and gaining game points. If the player misses the target the rock turns to dust. Stone Age was released in Brazil by CCE. A planned North America version by TechnoVision was never released.
